strings.plugin.netflow.setting.retention_flow_re: Flow record retention, in seconds (0 follows the retention)
strings.plugin.netflow.page.join: Joining flow records to logged connections
strings.plugin.netflow.page.join_help: How far after a logged connection a flow record may start and still be counted for it, and how long the flow records are kept. A volume measured by NetFlow is a second measure beside the logged one, never summed with it, and traffic between two clients behind one interface is in neither.
